beforeShellExecution.command: /bin/sh -c 'if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then HOME=$(cd ~ 2>/dev/null && pwd) || exit 2; export HOME; fi; exec "$HOME/.config/agent-guard/run.sh" --tool cursor'

beforeReadFile.command: /bin/sh -c 'if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then HOME=$(cd ~ 2>/dev/null && pwd) || exit 2; export HOME; fi; exec "$HOME/.config/agent-guard/run.sh" --tool cursor'

afterShellExecution.command: /bin/sh -c 'if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then HOME=$(cd ~ 2>/dev/null && pwd) || exit 2; export HOME; fi; exec "$HOME/.config/agent-guard/run.sh" --tool cursor'
